title: Kung Fu Panda (2008) - Impersonations at Dinner Scene
summary: 晚饭时阿宝给五侠做面，又用筷子和面条模仿师父 Shifu 逗大家笑。真 Shifu 突然出现，宣布大反派 Tai Lung 越狱了，冲着神龙卷轴来，只有神龙大侠能阻止他——也就是阿宝。

lines.en: You may be the scariest bandit in Haijin province, but you're a lousy tipper.
lines.zh: 你可能是海金省最可怕的土匪，但你给小费太抠了。

lines.en: Really? So... how'd you get out of there alive?
lines.zh: 真的？那……你怎么活着出来的？

lines.en: I mean, I didn't actually say that. But... I thought it. In... in my mind.
lines.zh: 呃，我其实没说出口。但……我想了。在……在心里。

lines.en: He could read my mind. He'd have been like "What?"
lines.zh: 他要是能读心，肯定会说“什么？”

lines.en: Order up! Hope you like it.
lines.zh: 上菜啦！希望你们喜欢。

lines.en: This is really good.
lines.zh: 这个真好吃。

lines.en: Now, come on. You should try my dad's secret ingredient soup. He actually knows the secret.
lines.zh: 哪里哪里。你们该尝尝我爸的秘方汤，他是真知道秘方。

lines.en: What are you talking about? This is amazing. Wow. You're a really good cook.
lines.zh: 说什么呢，这已经很棒了。哇，你厨艺真好。

lines.en: I wish my mouth was bigger.
lines.zh: 真希望我的嘴再大一点。

lines.en: Tigress, you've got to try this.
lines.zh: 悍娇虎，你一定得尝尝。

lines.en: It is said that the Dragon Warrior can survive for months at a time on nothing but the dew of a single ginkgo leaf and the energy of the universe.
lines.zh: 据说神龙大侠可以连续几个月只靠一片银杏叶上的露水和宇宙能量活着。

lines.en: I guess my body doesn't know it's the Dragon Warrior yet. It needs a lot more dew. And... universe juice.
lines.zh: 看来我的身体还不知道自己是神龙大侠。它需要更多露水……还有宇宙果汁。

lines.en: (as Shifu) You'll never be the Dragon Warrior unless you lose 500 pounds and brush your teeth.
lines.zh: （学师父）除非你减掉 500 磅再刷刷牙，否则你永远当不了神龙大侠。

lines.en: What is that noise you're making? — Master, I've never heard of it.
lines.zh: （学师父）你在发什么怪声？——师父，我从没听过。

lines.en: Work hard and... maybe some day... you will have ears like mine.
lines.zh: （学师父）好好练……也许有一天……你也会有我这样的耳朵。

lines.en: That's good. Ears. It's not working for you? I thought they were pretty good.
lines.zh: 不错吧？耳朵。你们觉得不像？我觉得挺像的。

lines.en: It's Shifu. Of course, it's Shifu. What do you think I'm doing?
lines.zh: 是师父啦。当然是师父，不然你们以为我在干嘛？

lines.en: Master Shifu!
lines.zh: 师父！

lines.en: You think this is funny!? Tai Lung has escaped from prison and you're acting like children!
lines.zh: 你们觉得好笑吗？！太郎越狱了，你们还在这像小孩一样胡闹！

lines.en: What? — He is coming for the Dragon Scroll, and you are the only one who can stop him!
lines.zh: 什么？——他冲着神龙卷轴来了，只有你能阻止他！

lines.en: And here I am saying you got no sense of humor. ... What, you're serious? And I have to...
lines.zh: 我还说您没幽默感呢……什么，您是认真的？那我得……

lines.en: Master Oogway'll stop him. He did it before. He'll do it again.
lines.zh: 乌龟大师会阻止他的。他以前做到过，这次也能。

lines.en: Oogway cannot! Not anymore.
lines.zh: 乌龟大师做不到了！再也不能了。

lines.en: Our only hope is the Dragon Warrior. — The panda? The panda!
lines.zh: 我们唯一的希望是神龙大侠。——那只熊猫？那只熊猫！

lines.en: Master, please let us stop Tai Lung! This is what you've trained us for.
lines.zh: 师父，让我们去阻止太郎吧！您训练我们就是为了这个。

lines.en: No, it is not your destiny to defeat Tai Lung! It is his!
lines.zh: 不，打败太郎不是你们的使命！是他的！

lines.en: Where'd he go?
lines.zh: 他人呢？

questions.q: 阿宝用面条和筷子在干什么？
options: 模仿师父 Shifu 逗大家笑
questions.explain: 他把筷子当耳朵，学 Shifu 说话：You will have ears like mine.

questions.q: 大家夸阿宝做的面，他回了一句 "I wish my mouth was bigger"——这是谁说的、什么意思？
options: 螳螂嘴小，觉得太好吃想一次吃更多
questions.explain: 小小的螳螂（Mantis）说：真希望我嘴大一点——好吃到想多吃。

questions.q: Shifu 突然出现，带来了什么消息？
options: Tai Lung 越狱了，要来抢神龙卷轴
questions.explain: Tai Lung has escaped from prison … coming for the Dragon Scroll.

questions.q: 最后 Shifu 说只有谁能打败 Tai Lung？
questions.explain: It is not your destiny … It is his!——指的是熊猫阿宝。
